📰 General

Kyiv Attack Stopped: Police Neutralize Gunman, Release Hostages •

Ukrainian police fatally shot a gunman who had killed six people and taken hostages in Kyiv’s Holosiivskyi district. The attack unfolded on Saturday, with the assailant opening fire on civilians before authorities intervened. Following a tense standoff, police successfully neutralized the threat and released the remaining hostages. Investigations are underway to determine the motive and circumstances surrounding the incident.

🌍 World

GSA Announces New Acting Commissioner Following Josh Gruenbaum’s Departure •

Josh Gruenbaum is stepping down from his role as commissioner of the Federal Acquisition Service at the General Services Administration. Laura Stanton, previously the Deputy Commissioner of FAS, has been appointed as the acting commissioner effective immediately. The transition comes after Gruenbaum’s tenure began in January 2025. Details regarding the reasons for his departure are currently unavailable, and the GSA has not released a formal statement. This change reflects a shift in leadership within the agency’s acquisition operations.

🦅 US

Malott Headlines UFC Winnipeg, Considered Canada’s Top Contender •

Canadian mixed martial artist Mike Malott is set to headline the UFC event in Winnipeg, marking a historic moment as only the third Canadian to achieve this feat. He joins Georges St-Pierre and Rory MacDonald as the only Canadians to have headlined an event within their home country. Analysts view Malott as the current best hope for a Canadian championship challenge, anticipating a dominant performance against a seasoned veteran. The event is expected to draw significant attention within the Canadian MMA community.

💰 Business

Flight Diverted From Chicago to New York Due to Reported Security Threat •

United Airlines Flight 412 from Chicago O’Hare International Airport to New York’s John F. Kennedy International Airport made an unscheduled landing at Pittsburgh International Airport on Saturday. The diversion occurred following a reported threat onboard, prompting immediate investigation by local authorities and the FBI. Passengers were deplaned and underwent screening before the flight resumed its journey to New York. The incident is currently under investigation, with details regarding the nature of the threat remaining undisclosed.

💻 Technology

Rare 911 Body Panels Fuel Lucrative Restomod Market, Valuing Thousands •

A collection of original body-in-white 911 panels, previously destined for scrap, has become a highly sought-after component in the burgeoning restomod market. These panels, created before the final paint and interior were applied, are now crucial for building high-end, modernized Porsche 911s. The demand stems from the desire to retain the classic 911 aesthetic while incorporating contemporary technology and reliability. Experts estimate these panels can fetch upwards of $75,000, demonstrating the value of this unique automotive resource.

🎭 Entertainment

Zendaya Dominates Met Gala, Showcasing Stunning Custom Valentino Gown •

Zendaya attended the 2024 Met Gala, held at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York City. She wore a custom-designed white Valentino gown featuring a dramatic, sculpted silhouette and intricate embellishments. The gown was praised by fashion critics and social media users alike for its innovative design and Zendaya’s confident presentation. The actress posed for photographers throughout the evening, solidifying her status as a major fashion icon.

🏅 Sports

Dvalishvili vs. Cejudo Main Event Scrapped Due to Injury Hours Before RAF 8 •

Henry Cejudo has withdrawn from his headliner bout against Merab Dvalishvili at RAF 8 due to an undisclosed injury. The fight, scheduled for Saturday night at the Liacouras Center in Philadelphia, is no longer the main event. RAF co-founder confirmed Cejudo’s withdrawal just hours before the event’s commencement. A replacement opponent for Dvalishvili has not yet been announced.

🔬 Science

Yellowstone’s Geothermal Power: Scientists Find Vast ‘River’ of Hot Rock •

A recent study published in the Daily Galaxy reveals that Yellowstone’s intense geothermal activity is likely driven by a massive, slow-moving flow of hot rock beneath North America. Researchers discovered evidence of this broad flow, challenging the previously held theory of a deep, vertical plume of magma fueling the park’s geysers and hot springs. The findings suggest a significantly larger and more diffuse heat source than previously imagined. This new understanding could dramatically alter the scientific community’s approach to studying and predicting Yellowstone’s volcanic behavior.

🩺 Health

Ancient DNA Reveals Human Evolution Rapidly Favors Traits Like Red Hair •

A recent study utilizing ancient DNA from nearly 16,000 individuals, led by Harvard University and the Broad Institute, indicates that natural selection has accelerated in human evolution. The research identified a significant shift in favored traits, with evidence suggesting increased selection for characteristics such as red hair and lower body fat. Scientists analyzed genetic data spanning several thousand years, revealing a more rapid adaptation to environmental pressures. This accelerated evolution contrasts with previously understood patterns of gradual genetic change within human populations.
